decisions.rationale: Low P/E reflects record margins (76.3% gross), not cheapness: EV/Sales and P/B exceed 5-year highs, net margin exceeds operating margin, and FCF conversion is falling. A commodity-cycle stock with 2.39 beta should be bought on normalised, not peak, earnings. Quality and net cash make it a re-entry candidate after a cycle reset.

The catalyst is real, but the plan's +12% target against a -10% stop is only about 1.2:1. With beta 2.45 and a binary earnings event, a gap can blow through the stop. The multiples are above AMD's own 5y maxima, so there is little room to absorb a disappointment. With an all-cash portfolio there is no need to chase.
